{{Top|leg}}
A '''percussion repeater cannon''' was a weapon that fired explosive projectiles. Some vessels of the [[Exocron Airfleet]] mounted them as part of their standard weaponry. The weapons were considered to be archaic by [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].
